description:
After her husband Hajin passes away in a plane crash, Sua's life falls apart.

Shortly after the funeral, her brother-in-law Woojin appears and suggests that they live together, seemingly indifferent to her grief. He continues to stay close to her, making his presence increasingly difficult to ignore...

"You're putting too much pressure on me right now."

Sua can't understand why she finds herself kissing her brother-in-law, who looks exactly like her late husband.

Caught between her longing for Hajin and the unfamiliar feelings developing toward Woojin, Sua gradually finds herself drawn deeper into their complicated relationship.

Yet an unsettling sense of déjà vu begins to emerge. 

As the memories and images of the two men overlap, she struggles to understand her own heart.

Who is the person I truly love?
